item.title: November 2026 Humble Choice
item.description:
Mafia: The Old Country + 2 DLC Packs


Genres: Action, Adventure

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 64.99 USD

Steam: mostly positive, 71% positive

Search on Steam

Make money moves for power, honor, and most importantly, the family in Mafia: The Old Country. Set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily, you play as Enzo Favara, an up-and-coming mobster who’s willing to risk everything to become the leader he’s destined to be. This thrilling third-person narrative is accentuated by stunning visuals, cinematic storytelling, and a tangible sense of authenticity. Plus, your purchase unlocks two high-octane DLC packs! The seedy underworld of crime and corruption eats lesser men alive, but do you have the skills and charisma to help Enzo rise to the top? Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.

SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance


Genres: Action

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 29.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 90% positive

Search on Steam

The way of the shinobi is back and better than ever in Shinobi: Art of Vengeance. Expect nothing less than combat greatness from the developers behind Streets of Rage 4 as you whiz across levels using your lightning-fast shinobi techniques to defeat foes before they know what hit ‘em. Choose from a vast arsenal of ninja tools like katanas, kunai, your fists, and more, and pair them with your upgradable abilities to overcome enemies and uncover Metroidvania-style alternate paths. Originally debuting in 1987, the Shinobi series is one of SEGA’s most iconic franchises. Don’t miss your opportunity to experience this colorful reimagining that oozes aura! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.

Yakuza 6: The Song of Life


Genres: Action, Adventure

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 19.99 USD

Steam: overwhelmingly positive, 95% positive, 3855 reviews

Search on Steam

You’ll be humming the high notes of Yakuza 6: The Song of Life for weeks the second you step into the shoes of certified badass Kazuma Kiryu. Fresh out of prison, Kiryu’s thrust into a tornado of family drama as he balances new parental responsibilities and long-standing criminal obligations. Your epic exploits from Onomichi, Hiroshima, to Kamurocho, Tokyo, are the ultimate iteration of the series’ blend of gritty crime rings, hyper-stylized combat, and all the vices these locales have to offer. Yakuza 6’s gripping story of loss, revenge, and salvation is easily one of the most compelling tales ever told within this long-standing franchise. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.

Crisol: Theater of Idols


Genres: Action, Adventure

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 20.98 USD

Steam: mostly positive, 76% positive, 137 reviews

Search on Steam

From the horror heavyweights at Blumhouse Games, Crisol: Theatre of Idols delivers heart-pumping horror FPS action with a unique twist: your blood is your ammunition. Push yourself to the brink of death to power your devastating attacks on gruesome enemies as you explore the cursed island of Tormentosa and uncover dark secrets. Your character is cursed with the power to manipulate blood to maximize offense or ensure survival as you navigate the twisted and chilling landscapes of Tormentosa. If you’re bold enough to brave the horror- and folklore-inspired atmosphere, then Crisol: Theatre of Idols will reward you with its bloody truths. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.

Space Haven


Genres: Indie, Strategy, RPG, Simulation

Platforms: linux, mac, windows

Retail price: 24.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 84% positive, 5024 reviews

Search on Steam

Space, the final frontier, and a place for you to call home in Space Haven! Embark on an intergalactic voyage in search of a new home for your crew of marooned travelers, where success depends on your ability to strategize and manage resources. This isn’t your typical base-building sim. Raise spaceships panel by panel, maintain livable gas and water conditions, manage the moods and temperaments of your crew, and so much more. Each crewmate feels alive with realistic needs and a slew of potential mental breakdowns around every corner. Balance the needs of your people and your mission as you navigate a fractured galaxy full of new friends and dangerous enemies. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.

DYSMANTLE


Genres: Action, Indie, Adventure, RPG, Simulation

Platforms: mac, windows

Retail price: 19.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 90% positive

Search on Steam

The world’s already gone to hell, so why not make the most of the situation? DYSMANTLE drops players into a post-apocalyptic island where it’s you, mutated creatures, and no friendly soul in sight. Navigate without borders as you collect resources in fully destructible environments, establish your camp for shelter and farming, fight for your life against vile abominations, cook delicious recipes that permanently upgrade your abilities, and do whatever it takes to survive another night. Life isn’t all bad; your character will never die of hunger and is fully customizable with new gear and skins to be found on your travels. Do you think you have what it takes to dismantle everything you’ve ever known? Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.

Squeakross: Home Squeak Home


Genres: Indie

Platforms: mac, windows

Retail price: 14.99 USD

Steam: overwhelmingly positive, 98% positive

Search on Steam

Make room for a cozy Nonogram game like no other: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home! For the first time ever, a mouse in the house is welcome! Solve 800+ diverse puzzles as you shape the perfect little dwelling for your rodent friend. Collect hundreds of unique decorations, stickers, and accessories as you decorate your home in a relaxing state of peace. Make your rodent residents radiate with fully customizable traits from whisker to tail. Squeaky-clean puzzles await! Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key before June 1st, 2027.
